[element-std-org-loc]
=== `<std-org-loc>` Standards Organization Location

Physical location(s) of a standards organization.

#### Related Elements

Several elements inside the container element <<element-std-org,`<std-org>`>> provide the name and location of a publishing or adopting standards organization: <<element-std-org-name,`<std-org-name>`>> provides an official, typically longer, name of an organization (“International Business Machinery”). <<element-std-org-abbrev,`<std-org-abbrev>`>> provides a short name or acronym for the organization (“IBM”). <<element-std-org-loc,`<std-org-loc>`>> names one or more locations where the organization operates, which may be as small as a city name or may include a complete address.

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-std-org,`<std-org>`>>
#### Description

Any combination of: Text, numbers, or special characters Address Elements <<element-addr-line,`<addr-line>`>> <<element-addr-line,Address Line>> <<element-city,`<city>`>> <<element-city,City (in an address)>> <<element-country,`<country>`>> <<element-country,Country (in an address)>> <<element-fax,`<fax>`>> <<element-fax,Fax Number (in address)>> <<element-institution,`<institution>`>> <<element-institution,Institution Name>> <<element-institution-wrap,`<institution-wrap>`>> <<element-institution-wrap,Institution Wrapper>> <<element-phone,`<phone>`>> <<element-phone,Phone Number: in an Address>> <<element-postal-code,`<postal-code>`>> <<element-postal-code,Postal Code: in an Address>> <<element-state,`<state>`>> <<element-state,State or Province (in an address)>> External Linking Elements <<element-email,`<email>`>> <<element-email,Email Address>> <<element-ext-link,`<ext-link>`>> <<element-ext-link,External Link>> <<element-uri,`<uri>`>> <<element-uri,Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)>>

#### Tagged Samples

#### Name and address of single standards organization

[source,xml]
....
...
<std-meta>
 <title-wrap>...</title-wrap>
 <std-ident>...</std-ident>
 <std-org-group>
  ...
  <std-org std-org-type="sdo" std-org-role="lead">
   <std-org-name>American Petroleum Institute</std-org-name>
   <std-org-abbrev>API</std-org-abbrev>
   <std-org-loc
    ><addr-line>1220 L Street, N.W.</addr-line>
    <city>Washington</city>
    <state>D.C.</state>
    <postal-code>20005</postal-code>
    <uri>http://www.api.org/</uri></std-org-loc>
  </std-org>
 </std-org-group>
 ...
</std-meta>
...
....

  <std-org-loc
   ><addr-line>2 Park Ave.</addr-line>
   <city>New York</city>
   <state>NY</state>
   <postal-code>10016</postal-code>
   <uri>https://www.asme.org/</uri></std-org-loc>
 </std-org>

  <std-org-name>CSA Group</std-org-name>

   <city>Mississauga</city>

   <country>Canada</country>
   <postal-code>L4W 5N6</postal-code>
   <uri>http://www.csagroup.org/</uri></std-org-loc>
 </std-org>
</std-org-group>
